payload.entry:
BASELINE: bob-mac-capture master 0e7eba4 had no .swift-format. First-body indent split (after matching final/public/private/class/struct/enum): 80 two-space files, 352 four-space files. Majority p99 line length in 4-space Sources is 96. Linux portable-check on master was not re-run; this phase measured the split then formatted.

FIX: added .swift-format (indent 4, tabWidth 4, lineLength 100, remaining keys from `swift format dump-configuration`). Re-indented the 80 two-space files by doubling leading spaces and adding the closer indent inside multiline string literals. git diff -w on Swift files empty (53090/53090). Did not edit AGENTS.md.

TESTS: just portable-check on athena passed (lint warnings only; 1695 tests, 0 failures). Mac ssh timed out. macos-precommit-gate has not landed. Draft PR https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/pull/9 SHA aab0211 CI run 40490755429 in progress; land only when Build and Test pass.

LIMITATIONS: Lint still warns on 4-space files (Package.swift #if indent, line length, rewrite rules). Those warnings existed against the 2-space default too. BobMacCapture* still needs the macOS CI job. Target task bob-cli-8k left open for the lander.

attach-source-skips done (verify branch): ambiguous stems now verify every candidate and attach only on exactly-one-pass; explicit REF -s FILE pairs skip the title check but still verify blocks; block-match thresholds unchanged. Added -f/--format json (pure-JSON envelope with per-row candidates, verdicts, matched/total). Files: src/native/ref_library/attach.rs, src/native/ref_library/cli.rs, tests/cli/ref_library/attach.rs (new: one-pass, zero-pass, two-pass, explicit-pair, JSON verdicts), docs/ref.md. Gates: just check exit 0 (fmt, clippy, full suite incl. 9 attach integration tests with real pandoc/xelatex/pdftotext; docs_reference golden ok; bob-docs check 447 passed). LIMITATION (for lander): no write pass ran — it needs a Bryan-approved /sase_gate turn. Read-only dry run on athena, 4 canonical research sidecars as -s: summary 38 attached, 262 skipped. Of the 47 old ambiguous stems, 36 now attach (1-of-N verified; plan-vs-report collisions resolve via title check) and 11 stay skipped (ambiguous: 0 of 2 verified). 35 title mismatches still need human-reviewed explicit pairs; pairing list (REF :: candidate FILE) extracted from -f json dry run, 35 lines in /tmp/attach-pairings.txt and /tmp/attach-dry.json on athena. Gate commands: (1) write pass: BOB_DIR=/home/bryan/bob bob ref attach-source -s <bob-cli research> -s <sase research> -s <actstat research> -s <tailnet research> (expect 1 revertable batch of 38); (2) per approved pair only: bob ref attach-source <REF> -s <FILE>. No PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP discovered.

Verified: just check exit 0 (fmt, clippy, full cargo suite incl. 5 new attach tests green with real render toolchain); read-only dry run on athena over 4 research sidecars: 38 would attach (36 disambiguated 1-of-N, 2 single), 11 ambiguous 0-of-2 stay skipped, 35 title mismatches listed for review; no vault writes made, vault tree clean. Deployment: `chezmoi diff` for the two targets showed only this change; applied only those targets with `chezmoi apply --force ~/bin/bob_research_capture ~/.config/sase/sase.yml` and verified installed helper/config identical to source. Post-commit hook ran the standard whole-home update. No live-report smoke capture performed.

Rechecked all five hash-suffixed rows (493 chat rows total): first two have same-title clean counterparts with saved-source pointers (PDF bytes differ, so no content equality inferred) -> archive proposals; two __gem singles have no counterpart -> hash-strip rename proposals (preview currently refuses `not in sync`, needs Mac scan); abandoned annotated fifth has 1 highlight/comment plus inbound link from sase_final_polish.md -> preserve, gated coordinated archive only, no rename command. No live repair executed; no generic archive command added.

Limitations: rename -d previews refuse `not in sync` until a Mac scan runs; gated writes require a Bryan-approved /sase_gate turn under the parent epic. PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: none beyond the gated repairs already recorded in the proposal.
